title: Marketing & Operations Intern
skills: Supporting day-to-day budget administration and financial workflows by preparing and tracking purchase requests and purchase orders, following up on procurement and invoice status, and keeping supporting documentation accurate and up to date.

Using Excel or Google Sheets, presentation tools, and approved AI solutions to improve reporting speed and quality, information organization, and recurring tasks.

Strong organizational and project-coordination skills, with the ability to manage different priorities, maintain accurate information, pay attention to detail, meet deadlines, and consistently follow through on assigned tasks.
Comfort organizing and reviewing information and data, identifying relevant patterns, and clearly communicating the main findings.
A proactive, resourceful, and collaborative mindset. You ask thoughtful questions, look for solutions, take responsibility for assigned work, and have the drive to move tasks forward.

Curiosity, adaptability, and an open mindset toward AI, with an interest in using new tools responsibly to improve efficiency, solve problems, and propose better ways of working. Previous experience with project-management or AI tools is a plus, but not required.
description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As part of the Passenger Marketing team, you will support the day-to-day execution of marketing priorities for selected markets in Mexico and Colombia. Working closely with a Marketing Analyst and Senior Marketing Manager, you will help organize information, coordinate initiatives, and keep assigned workstreams moving from the initial request through execution and results reporting.

This is a learn-by-doing internship. You will begin with clearly defined support responsibilities and have the opportunity to take on more complex deliverables and greater ownership as you build your skills, demonstrate strong performance, and deepen your understanding of the business.

In this role, you'll be...


Supporting day-to-day budget administration and financial workflows by preparing and tracking purchase requests and purchase orders, following up on procurement and invoice status, and keeping supporting documentation accurate and up to date.
Maintain trackers and reports across campaigns, owned-channel communications, and other marketing activities; collect, organize, and validate information; and translate results into clear reports, presentations, and key learnings.
Using Excel or Google Sheets, presentation tools, and approved AI solutions to improve reporting speed and quality, information organization, and recurring tasks.
Supporting the planning and day-to-day coordination of marketing initiatives by keeping project plans and timelines updated, following up on pending actions, and flagging potential blockers or delays.
Gathering relevant inputs and helping translate approved business needs into clear briefs and structured requests, while coordinating feedback, reviews, and approvals with creative, operational, legal, and other partner teams.
Support the execution of owned-channel communications, including in-app messages, push notifications, SMS, and WhatsApp. As your experience, performance, and capabilities grow, you may also help deploy broader campaigns by coordinating asset delivery and organization, following up on media requirements and plans, and supporting handoffs between creative, media, and other partner teams.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree—from the sixth semester onward—in Business Administration, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and English. Advanced working proficiency in English is required; C1 is preferred.
Intermediate knowledge of Excel and/or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, and charts, as well as good working knowledge of PowerPoint and/or Google Slides.
Strong organizational and project-coordination skills, with the ability to manage different priorities, maintain accurate information, pay attention to detail, meet deadlines, and consistently follow through on assigned tasks.
Comfort organizing and reviewing information and data, identifying relevant patterns, and clearly communicating the main findings.
A proactive, resourceful, and collaborative mindset. You ask thoughtful questions, look for solutions, take responsibility for assigned work, and have the drive to move tasks forward.
Curiosity, adaptability, and an open mindset toward AI, with an interest in using new tools responsibly to improve efficiency, solve problems, and propose better ways of working. Previous experience with project-management or AI tools is a plus, but not required.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Internship Program provides an immersive, 12-month journey where you’ll work on impactful projects that drive Visa’s mission forward. As a Visa intern, you’ll build valuable connections across the organization, sharpen your communication and business acumen, and gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, global environment.

Throughout the program, you’ll have exclusive access to interactive workshops and learning sessions designed to deepen your expertise, expand your industry knowledge, and elevate your professional skillset. You won’t just be learning, you’ll be contributing, collaborating, and innovating every step of the way.

The experience culminates in an exciting final presentation, where you’ll showcase your project achievements, share key insights, and present your recommendations to Visa’s leaders and stakeholders. This is your chance to demonstrate your business impact, highlight your personal growth, and align your work with Visa’s vision for the future.

Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) is Visa’s advisory and consulting organization. It helps banks, fintechs, merchants, acquirers, governments, and other payment ecosystem participants improve growth, profitability, customer engagement, and payment performance through a combination of consulting, data analytics, economics, and implementation support.

As a VCA Intern, you will contribute to initiatives that help internal and external stakeholders achieve strategic objectives. You will have opportunities to take on meaningful responsibilities, expand your skills, and gain exposure to different areas of the business while working with experienced professionals on impactful projects.

All Visa roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Some job duties and projects could include, but are not limited to:


Engage with VCA team members and other internal partners to support consulting engagements 
Contribute to activities across the consulting lifecycle and leverage AI tools where appropriate 
Assist with business development through market research and proposal preparation 
Support project implementation and help document best practices for global knowledge sharing 
Coordinate logistics and operational activities for the VCA team in Mexico 
Participate in client engagement areas such as portfolio optimization, product design and launch, digital strategy, and transformation 
Prepare materials for internal governance updates and thought leadership initiatives 
Support alignment of the consulting practice with internal processes and operational standards 
Assist with executive communications, including drafting content and managing communication trackers 
Collaborate on deliverables that help maintain high-quality client engagement 


Remember, at Visa, we see our employees as our most valuable asset and we are excited to support and witness your growth within our organization.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications


Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, International Business, or a related field, with an expected graduation date between November 2027 and March 2028 
Interpersonal and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across teams 
Interest in financial services, strategy, and emerging technologies 
Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and present insights 
Clear, structured communication skills in both written and verbal formats 
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and comfort learning new technologies


Preferred Qualifications


Bilingual in Spanish and English 
Experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills to business challenges 
Ability to adapt to ambiguity and learn quickly in a dynamic environment 
Familiarity with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for data and presentation development 
Awareness of AI tools and a willingness to integrate them into day-to-day work 


Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

description:
¿Qué hace que DHL sea una gran Compañía?

¡Nuestra gente y nuestra cultura, basadas en el respeto y los resultados!

DHL Compañía #1 en servicio de logística global está presente en más de 220 países, lo que la convierte en la empresa más internacional. Description

Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in helping shape the future of movies and television? Do you want to help define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. On Prime Video, customers can customize their viewing experience and find their favourite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies Fallout, Heads of State, Reacher, Red One, Road House, The Accountant 2, The Boys, The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, and The Summer I Turned Pretty; locally produced Originals such as The Girlfriend, Steal, Clarkson’s Farm, Molly-Mae: Behind it All, My Fault: London and Last One Laughing UK; licensed fan favorites such as Nine Perfect Strangers S2 and The Assassin; Prime member exclusive access to coverage of live sports including UEFA Champions League and NBA, and acclaimed sports documentaries. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.

This is a uniquely dual-natured role that sits at the intersection of operational excellence and strategic vision. As Social Channels & Platforms Manager you will define the strategic direction for your assigned Social platforms, while being quick to adjust the operation of our social handles to optimize results. You will be the guardian of editorial plans, orchestrating with multiple stakeholder teams (titles, Brand, agencies) to ensure the best content is provided. You'll adjust quickly to results, be a first-adopter to new features and keep innovating on new handle opportunities, new editorial, platform and organic boosting tactics. You'll roll up your sleeves to solve tactical challenges when needed, and step back to develop strategies that elevate our social presence at scale. If you thrive in environments where no two days look the same, this role could be for you.

Key job responsibilities


 Manage day to day Prime Video social media handles, overseeing editorial plans and problem solving.
 Allocate organic boosting budgets optimally.
 Define the strategic approach to Social platforms.
 Be agile, shifting quickly to respond to performance signals, platform algorithm changes and new features.

 Partner with social platforms to identify new opportunities and develop innovative activations.
 Track, analyze and report results on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadence.
 Unblock issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make recommendations for trade-offs, and meet delivery timelines.


About The Team

About the team

Amazon MGM Studios is the home for talent, creating and producing Original films and television series for a global audience. Original series premiere exclusively on Prime Video, which is available in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Amazon MGM Studios also produces and acquires Original movies for theatrical release and exclusively for Prime Video.

Basic Qualifications


 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience

 Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Corporativo Mérida




En la vibrante ciudad de Mérida, Yucatán, se encuentran nuestras oficinas corporativas, un edificio de alta tecnología ubicado en la mejor zona de la ciudad, con acceso directo a una de sus plazas más icónicas, que ofrece una variedad gastronomía y entretenimiento de lujo. Agencia Digital 




Somos una agencia digital líder, especializada en diseñar y ejecutar estrategias digitales que impulsan el crecimiento online de nuestros clientes. Nuestro equipo multidisciplinario, que incluye expertos en Social Media, Marketing, Inbound, Copywriting y Diseño, trabaja de la mano para crear las campañas más innovadoras y efectivas en el sector de la hotelería de lujo. Gestionar y optimizar la presencia en redes sociales de las marcas asignadas a través de la creación, planificación e implementación de estrategias de contenido integradas. Planificación y Estrategia de Contenido

• Anticipar oportunidades de contenido y ajustar estrategia según el desempeño en tiempo real.

• Redactar copys atractivos y alineados con la estrategia para posts, stories, reels y captions.

Adaptar contenido a especificaciones técnicas y formatos requeridos por cada plataforma.




Estrategias Orgánicas y Pagadas

• Implementar estrategias de crecimiento orgánico (SEO, hashtags, colaboraciones).

• Colaborar con equipos de marketing en la ejecución de campañas pagadas (Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads).




Análisis y Reporte

• Identificar tendencias y patrones en el comportamiento de la audiencia.

Coordinación y Comunicación

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A Day In The Life

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities


Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients
Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets
Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
Maintaining client communications and sentiment
Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department


Role Requirements


Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps 
Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


5% or lower client churn
Manage 8-10 mid level clients 
Maintain $22,000 RPE


Most Important Things (MITs)


Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap. 
Responsible for using data insights along with consumer and brand research to orchestrate a sales/messaging/visual strategy.


Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

MX Salary Range: $367,400 - $450,000

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About The Role

We are looking to hire a Customer Success Associate to join our team in Mexico! The CSA is responsible for supporting a large portfolio of nonprofit and corporate customers through structured engagement activities, product adoption support, and routine outreach across key lifecycle milestones. Working within established processes and with close guidance from senior team members, this role focuses on building foundational customer relationships, executing defined engagement activities, and developing core competencies in customer health monitoring and Bonterra's SaaS solutions. The Pooled CSM I contributes to customer outcomes by applying established frameworks, following through on commitments, and escalating risks and issues in a timely manner.

What You'll Do:

SCALABLE CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT (35%)


Execute structured outreach to an assigned portfolio of customers at defined journey milestones including onboarding, adoption, and value realization, following established engagement frameworks and playbooks. 
Support delivery of many engagement formats including webinars, office hours, and digital programs under the direction of senior team members. 
Respond to customer inquiries and direct customers to appropriate resources, tools, and next steps to support product utilization. 


CUSTOMER HEALTH MONITORING (30%)


Track usage trends and health indicators using internal tools, flagging early signals of risk or disengagement to senior team members for review and action. 
Apply defined frameworks to support customers in progressing through key product journey milestones, with regular direction from senior colleagues. 
Participate in structured mitigation efforts for at-risk customers as directed by senior team members. 


PRODUCT KNOWLEDGE AND CUSTOMER FEEDBACK (20%)


Develop foundational knowledge of Bonterra's product suite, building the ability to speak confidently with customers about core features and workflows relevant to their goals. 
Capture and document customer feedback and observations accurately, communicating findings to internal stakeholders in a timely manner. 
Apply learnings from customer interactions and team feedback to improve the quality of customer communications and engagement activities. 


OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE (15%)


Maintain accurate and current records in Gainsight, following established data entry standards and engagement frameworks. 
Follow defined processes for portfolio management and customer outreach, seeking guidance from senior team members to develop skills and improve practices. 
Surface observations about customer patterns or process questions to senior colleagues for review and direction.

Applies established frameworks and playbooks to deliver reliable, consistent engagement to customers across a large portfolio. 
Communicates clearly and professionally with customers and internal partners, practicing active listening in all interactions. 
Demonstrates a growth mindset by seeking feedback, asking thoughtful questions, and applying learnings to improve performance. 
Escalates risks, issues, and uncertainties to senior team members in a timely and organized manner. 
Participates actively in team collaboration and shows curiosity about customer goals, Bonterra's product suite, and the broader mission-driven customer base. 


OUTCOME EXPECTATIONS – THE “IMPACT”


Customers across the assigned portfolio receive timely, professional outreach at defined lifecycle milestones. 
Account health data and engagement records are maintained accurately and consistently in Gainsight. 
Risks and escalations are surfaced promptly, enabling senior team members to take appropriate action. 
Customer interactions reflect Bonterra's values and contribute to a positive overall customer experience at scale. 


Requirements


1 or more years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, customer service, or a comparable customer-facing role. 
Demonstrated ability to build relationships, follow through on commitments, and communicate effectively in a professional setting. 
Familiarity with CRM or customer success platforms such as Gainsight, Salesforce, or similar tools, or willingness to learn. 
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish. 
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a structured, team-supported environment. 


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting nonprofit organizations or social sector customers.

description:
About Us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

Strong preference for candidates based anywhere on the East Coast, particularly those within the Eastern Time Zone.

As a Customer Success Technical Manager at Pencil, you’ll lead by example: managing one of our high-impact accounts, designing scalable adoption strategies, and helping define how we deliver customer success at scale. description:
The Opportunity

Join Sitetracker as a Customer Success Manager and play a key role in helping customers across North America maximize the value of our platform. You'll manage a diverse portfolio of customers, including Spanish-speaking organizations, ensuring they achieve measurable business outcomes through strong adoption, proactive engagement, and long-term partnership.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong relationship-building skills with a data-driven, strategic approach to Customer Success. You'll have the opportunity to develop creative and scalable engagement strategies, anticipate customer needs, and identify opportunities for growth while proactively mitigating retention risks.

You'll work across different industries, customer personas, and cultural environments, bringing together customer insights, technology, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver meaningful results. Your ability to communicate effectively in both English and Spanish will be essential to building trusted relationships and driving customer success across the portfolio.

What You'll Do

Experience managing a portfolio of customer accounts, establishing engagement cadences, maintaining success plans, and driving measurable adoption and retention outcomes

Experience leveraging digital engagement tools, including email, video, and virtual meetings, to maintain meaningful customer relationships and communicate business value
Ability to develop creative, persona-based communication frameworks that anticipate customer needs and improve engagement across a diverse portfolio
Demonstrated success engaging hard-to-reach customers through innovative outreach strategies and scalable digital communication

Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, competing customer needs, and engagement activities effectively
Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms to maintain accurate account plans, success plans, customer health information, and engagement records
Ability to analyze product usage, customer health metrics, and engagement data to identify trends, prioritize activities, and translate insights into actionable plans
Experience creating reporting dashboards, trackers, or automated workflows that improve portfolio visibility and enable proactive risk identification
Proven ability to develop and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and scalability across a Customer Success organization

Begin establishing consistent, personalized communication cadences across your portfolio, including English- and Spanish-speaking customers

MoveSmart Rentals is hiring an experienced Account Manager to manage existing client relationships, retain dissatisfied clients, influence important decisions, sell relevant services, and keep multiple active files moving from beginning to completion.

Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns, you will receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.

This position offers expected annual compensation of approximately C$35,000–C$45,000, consisting of base pay plus performance bonuses.

MXN $10,000 net per month base salary + performance incentives







Build smarter. Think commercially. Make things happen.


BabaCorp is an emerging Mexican digital business consulting initiative focused on technology, AI, marketing, business development, and smarter ways of working. We're looking for a curious, creative, highly tech-savvy person who loves research, thinks commercially, and enjoys turning ideas into action.




You'll work directly with leadership on real business projects, explore new technologies, support commercial growth, and help build practical systems that make businesses work better. Marketing & Creative Execution

Research content ideas, industry trends, audiences, and campaign opportunities.

Bring ideas to the table and help turn them into polished, useful deliverables.

AI, Automation & Digital Operations

Use AI tools to improve research, writing, analysis, and everyday workflows.
Work with Monday.com, CRM platforms, project management systems, and digital collaboration tools.
Explore opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency.
Help maintain organized systems, accurate information, clear priorities, and reliable follow-through.

Ownership & Execution

Take assigned projects from brief to delivery.
Identify blockers early and suggest practical solutions.
Manage priorities, communicate progress, and close the loop on commitments.
Work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue.







WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

A degree in Marketing, Business, Market Research, Communications, or a related field.
Advanced English and Spanish, written and spoken. Strong professional English is essential.
Excellent research skills and the ability to find, verify, synthesize, and communicate information.
Genuine interest in sales, business development, technology, and digital business.

You don't need to know every platform already. We value people who learn quickly, experiment thoughtfully, ask good questions, and take pride in their work.

Location: Downtown / Centro Histórico, Morelia, Michoacán, Mexico.

MXN $10,000 net per month in base pay, subject to the agreed employment and payroll arrangements.

Send your CV and a short introduction in English answering these three questions:

You’ll partner closely with Creative, Analytics, Product/Bliss Point, and senior Channel Leads in your Pod, communicate clearly, and document what works so the team can reuse it. Client‑Centric

title: GTM Manager - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




GTM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:
About Hilbert

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

The problem you are hired to solve

Hilbert's pipeline comes from Executive dinners, advisor firesides at the office, briefings at the customer's offices, side events at conferences. Events and warm introductions produce most of the deals that reach a second meeting.

Today those rooms happen when a founder or a regional sales leader makes them happen. There is no calendar, no owner, no follow-up standard and no count of which room produced which meeting. The Americas pipeline spans the United States, Mexico, Brazil and the Andean markets, and the sellers in each of them are building their own event plans from scratch.

That is this role: own the Americas event programme end to end, decide what goes on it, and measure it on the budget-holder meetings it produces.

What the role is

The Field Marketing Manager owns the strategy and the execution of every in-person and live-audience programme in the Americas. The job has two halves.

The first is the outside calendar: which conferences and industry events Hilbert joins, at what level, and what it does there. You recommend the list with the reasoning, and then you run each one, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.

The second is the programmes Hilbert hosts itself: executive dinners in the hub cities, advisor and investor firesides and podcast recordings at the office, customer roundtables and webinars. You design the format, the audience and the guest list, propose it, and then produce every part of it, including the promotion and the follow-up that turn attendance into meetings.

You plan both halves with the regional sales leaders, run them yourself, and report what each one produced. You are the first field marketer in the Americas. Your counterpart in EMEA runs the same programme there, and you build the shared playbook together.

What the role is not


Not content production. The founders and the product marketing lead decide what Hilbert says publicly and write the materials. You decide where it is said, to whom, and what happens the next morning.
Not paid acquisition. Hilbert runs no paid demand programmes today and this role does not start one.


The impact you will have


Decide the Americas calendar for the year with the regional sales leaders: which outside events to join, which events to host and in which office cities, which accounts in the room, and what each one has to produce. Recommend it with the reasoning and own it once agreed.
Run the executive dinner series in the hub cities, with guest lists drawn from target accounts and late-stage deals, and a follow-up plan agreed with the sellers before the invitations go out.
Own Hilbert's presence at the conferences you chose, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.
Design and produce the office programmes: advisor and investor firesides, live-audience podcast recordings, customer roundtables and webinars. You propose the format and the guest, and then you produce the whole thing, from the invitation to the recording to what is published afterwards.
Run pre-event targeting and post-event follow-up with sellers so that attendance becomes meetings within the week, not the quarter.
Manage vendors, venues, budgets and the partners who co-host with Hilbert.
Promote every programme through the channels Hilbert uses, LinkedIn and the newsletter among them, within the review process the company sets for public content.
Track every programme in the CRM: invited, attended, met, advanced. Report it monthly and change the calendar on what the numbers say.
Write the playbook, so that a dinner in Mexico City runs to the same standard as one in New York, and so that the next region can copy it.


How you are measured


Meetings with budget holders at target accounts that trace to a programme you ran.
Late-stage deals that advanced within thirty days of an event their buyer attended.
Cost per qualified meeting, by format.
Programmes delivered on the date and budget agreed.


What we look for


Four or more years in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company with an enterprise sales motion, with end-to-end ownership of programmes from guest list to follow-up.
Has built an event strategy, not only executed one. Can show a calendar they designed, what they chose to join, what they chose to host, what they turned down, and what each produced.
Has run executive dinners and small, senior rooms and can show which meetings and deals came out of them. Has also run a conference presence with speakers, side events and a meeting schedule.
Has designed and produced an owned format from nothing: a dinner series, a podcast, a fireside or a webinar programme that ran more than once because it worked.
Works as a partner to sellers: plans the room with them, holds them to the follow-up, and is trusted with the account list.
Operationally exact. Vendors, venues, budgets, registration, name badges and the follow-up list are all yours, and you keep every one of them on track.
Writes a clear invitation, a clear brief for a speaker and a clear report for a sales leader.
Fluent in English and Spanish. The Americas programme runs in both.
Comfortable at startup pace, with a programme to build, no agency behind you at first, and a founder's calendar to work around.
Able to travel around 30 percent across the United States and Latin America.


Nice to have: Portuguese; experience with HubSpot; a network among CMOs and growth leaders in retail, grocery, QSR or banking; experience at a company that sold to the same buyers Hilbert sells to; experience building a field programme from nothing.

Your first ninety days


Weeks 1 to 3. Meet every seller in the Americas and read the pipeline. Audit the events run so far and what they produced. Take over the next dinner already on the calendar.
Weeks 4 to 8. Recommend the Americas calendar through the next two quarters: the outside events to join, the programmes to host, and why. Run two programmes end to end, with follow-up tracked in the CRM.
Weeks 9 to 12. Report the first ninety days by format and cost per meeting. Agree the shared playbook with your EMEA counterpart. Tell us which formats to drop.


You will inherit a brand system, a target-account list, an advisor network that opens doors and a track record of dinners that worked. You will not inherit a calendar or a team. Both are deliberate.

Reporting and location


Reports to the Head of GTM Strategy and Operations. Works daily with the regional sales leaders for North America and Latin America, the product marketing lead and the founders.
Based in San Francisco, New York or Mexico City, hybrid. Travel around 30 percent.


Why join us

At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go.

Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. UU. y Asia. Nosotros lo estamos construyendo para el público hispanohablante, con producción propia en Latinoamérica. description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role of a Partner Marketing Manager at Canonical

Canonical is looking for a channel marketing manager who will be responsible for developing our strategic relationships with a set of global partners . Canonical partners with the leading companies in technology across public cloud (Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Oracle…), silicon (ARM, Intel, Qualcomm, Mediatek, Nvidia, Xilinx…), hardware vendors (Dell, HP, HPE, Lenovo). As our business increasingly depends on partners, the scope of our partnership grows every year (GSI, software vendors, IoT…). We are thus looking for an individual, who will not only drive successful marketing activities with our partners but also shape our partner programs.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

This role reports to the Head of Partner Marketing.

Location:This role will be based remotely in the Americas region.

What your day will look like


Build joint go-to-market plans with partners, from messaging to pipeline generation
Create and deliver integrated campaigns, product launches, webinar series, industry announcements and core content in collaboration with partners.

Continue to develop Canonical's partner activities to scale our partner programs

description:
About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands.

We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality.

We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz.

For more information, visit applydigital.com.

LOCATION

APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly.

The preferred candidate should be based either in Canada or Latin America, working in hours that align to PT (Pacific Timezone).

THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Consultant embedded with our client, a major sports league, you will help build video experiences across web, mobile, and connected devices.

This is a technically demanding space, spanning live streaming infrastructure and video delivery pipelines.

You will go deep with engineering teams, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and hold your own in conversations with vendors and architects.

Working alongside the Lead Product Manager on the Video team, you will own roadmap execution and day-to-day delivery, collaborating with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to ship with quality and velocity.

You will be an active contributor to product strategy: leading roadmap conversations, identifying new opportunities, developing use cases, and helping define initiatives from the ground up.

You will own meaningful scope across the product lifecycle, from discovery and problem definition through launch, with direct exposure to senior product and business leadership at one of the world's most recognized sports entertainment brands.

Responsibilities

Strategy

Drive roadmap and strategy conversations for video: opportunity identification, initiative sizing, and prioritization.

Help shape the video roadmap with the Lead PM: what goes on it, not just what ships.

Identify new product opportunities across streaming and monetization.

Bring structured thinking to early-stage ideas and develop them into business cases.

Stay close to industry trends in streaming media and emerging platforms, bring relevant signals back to the team, and influence direction.

Stakeholder & Product Development

Build direct relationships with client stakeholders across product, engineering, and business teams.

Lead the development of user-facing features: gather requirements, synthesize feedback, define success metrics.

Drive new initiative discovery (interviews, use-case development, competitive research) as the team explores new product surface areas.

Keep video consistent across web, mobile, CTV, and every app, and work through tradeoffs between platform teams.

Report on outcomes in business terms (engagement, playback quality, monetization), using QoE and analytics data.

Own product areas end to end, from problem definition through launch.

Delivery & Execution

Keep the video backlog healthy: grooming, ticket quality, user stories, sprint tracking, and release readiness.

Coordinate across the vendor ecosystem, including the video player, encoding/pipeline, video analytics and observability, and casting and cross-device continuity.

Hold vendors to their commitments and evaluate technical tradeoffs.

Translate product direction into well-scoped spec docs and keep them accurate as work evolves.

Track releases and report on delivery, surfacing risks and blockers early.

Serve as the connective tissue between platform teams, engineering, QA, design, and external partners.

Requirements

5+ years of product management experience on a digital product team.

Sharp product instincts: you lead roadmap conversations, spot what's missing, and push back when something isn't right.

Track record of taking products from concept to launch.

Curiosity about the business, not just the backlog.

You want to understand why things are being built, not just what.

Clear, precise written communication.

Your PRDs and updates don't require follow-up questions.

Solid organization and follow-through.

Comfort working with external technical vendors or partners and holding people to commitments.

Fluent English

Based in Latin America

Working PST Timezone

NICE TO HAVE

Ability to analyze product data and translate insights into actionable improvements.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including with senior client leadership.

Project delivery experience, such as facilitating agile ceremonies (standup, sprint planning, retrospectives) and managing timelines, risks, and dependencies.

Familiarity with third-party streaming platforms, analytics tools, and player integrations.

Working knowledge of AI tools for PM work, such as prompt engineering, AI-assisted research, and LLM tools for synthesis and planning, and an interest in applying them to PM workflows.

Prior consulting or embedded client experience, and comfort operating in a matrixed environment.

Experience with analytics or observability platforms (Adobe, Amplitude, Mixpanel, etc).

WHY THIS ROLE?

You'll work embedded inside one of the most recognized sports leagues in the world, on a product used by tens of millions of fans.

You'll get deep exposure to a sophisticated, high-stakes technology stack spanning live streaming, video delivery, and monetization, the kind of experience that accelerates a PM career.

Opportunity to grow.

As you build trust and show product leadership, you can take on broader scope within the engagement.

$100,000 - $150,000 a year

LIFE AT APPLY

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY.

We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow.

Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

Agentic Delivery: Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes.

Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

An inclusive and safe environment: We're truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.

AI & Strategic Upskilling: Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.

Generous vacation policy: Work-life balance is key to our team's success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.

Flexible work arrangements: We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.

APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated.

We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs.

Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section.

THE ORGANIZATION

The Entrepreneurs’ Organization (EO) is a high-quality support network of 20,000 business founders and owners in 220 chapters and 80 countries worldwide. EO’s purpose is to move the world forward by unlocking the full potential of entrepreneurs. Since 1987, EO has helped entrepreneurs achieve transformational growth through the power of life-enhancing connections, shared experiences, and collaborative learning. Guided by EO’s core values: trust and respect, thirst for learning, think big, be bold, and together we grow, EO’s international staff collaborates successfully across diverse cultures. As an EO employee, you will gain access to the world’s top experts in entrepreneurship, grow beyond your perceived limits, and make

breakthroughs as you refine and realize your personal goals. EO’s competitive total rewards package, flexible work environment, and generous professional development resources are frequently cited as among the most popular benefits of working at EO.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Product Delivery is part of the team that helps to plan, co-design, and execute global programs (in-person and hybrid) within the products department, including global learning, forum, and communities. This individual partners with top content providers and top higher education institutions and vendors; develops and executes virtual programs (such as Nano Learning, Powerhouse speakers series), and forum events, among other initiatives.

This team member adds value by acquiring and overseeing programs from start to finish, including negotiating with vendors, advocating and negotiating new partnerships, prepping speakers, HEI and service providers for our unique audience, seeing tailor-made executive education programs through to execution, and conducting needs assessments for providing training opportunities according to member challenges. They also help to deliver product trainings, signature events, and virtual programming. They serve as an advanced expert in delivery and evaluation of products and serve as a partner to key member volunteer efforts. They assist the Director with audits of programs and take an advanced role during training of staff and members as well as large-scale events.

Staying cool under stress and pressure, delivering on deadlines, demonstrating agility, creative thinking, a can- do attitude, global mindset, and a thirst for continual learning are all musts. The Senior Manager liaises with various member teams to deliver on action plans and works cooperatively with learning colleagues for a range of Products initiatives from live to virtual events.

Takes lead product delivery and evaluation role for assigned signature events and projects
Serves as staff design expert for member engagement opportunities (live and virtual). Brings relevant expertise in program delivery, logistics, marketing, and engagement experience to community initiatives. Supports and assigns staff support as needed. 
Ensures successful onsite/online leadership program delivery, collaboration with internal and external units, and data reports
Provides accurate and timely data reports after each iteration and year and works with the analysis team to evaluate the forum leadership products. Provides expertise during times of evaluation and gives insight into areas of improvement and trends. Maintains an active learning component to understand competitor practices and offerings. 
Manage assigned products and programs from needs assessment to execution and evaluation. 
Evaluate learning, forum, and community programs across the world, conducts RFPs, and manage the vendor selection process. 
Serve as product owner and event organizer, requiring oversight of product data, financial records, marketing, etc. 
Liaise with the products team and products portfolio to gather stakeholder input and adjust product delivery according to plan and budget. Co-design tailor-made programs that fit our members' needs and provide input to curriculum delivery, including agenda, content, and speakers. Conduct site visits as necessary. 
Negotiate partnerships with Higher Education Institutions (HEI) and content providers (including international speakers and speaker bureaus). 
Market products to users. Oversee registrations and member inquiries. 
Evaluate programs, conduct program debriefing, suggest program improvements, and implement changes. 
Track program analytics and reports. 
Maintain an active learning component, including competitor analyses, new learning technologies, and best practices across the industry; as well as being knowledgeable of future trends in the learning industry.

Bachelor’s degree in social sciences, education, education technology, or related fields of study. In lieu of education, at least four years of similar project management experience, including organizing people and programs and coordinating marketing. 
Experience with adult learning, event, instructional design, project management, contract negotiation, and associations all pluses. 
Must have strong ability to work in teams with high accountability, willingness to work with ease across cultures, geographies, and time zones, and strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Fluency in a second language and international experience are all pluses.
